data.title: Amy Acton Unhurt After Armed Assailant Lunges at Ohio Campaign Stop
data.description: According to CNBC, an armed assailant lunged at Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton on Sunday during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair, injuring several people, campaign officials said. The suspect knocked volunteers to the ground and was arrested with multiple weapons, according to Mahoning County Democratic Party chairman Chris Anderson. Acton was not injured, while campaign officials said multiple people were hurt.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Oil Rises After US Strikes Iranian Tankers, Tehran Restricts Strait of Hormuz Area
data.description:
Oil climbed after the US attacked Iranian tankers and Tehran declared a new restricted zone outside the Strait of Hormuz, according to Bloomberg.

The moves raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the waterway.

data.title: BONK Holds Near Highs As USELESS And MARSCOIN Reversal Deepens
data.description: BONK, USELESS and MARSCOIN are the three meme coins to watch after two of them surged more than 370% since Aug. 31 before reversing sharply on Sunday, while BONK closed higher and near recent highs. According to BeInCrypto, BONK broke above a downtrend, USELESS rejected resistance after a 373% run, and MARSCOIN posted the riskiest setup with the widest gap to support.

data.title: Toyota Plans 40% Increase in Non-Vehicle Sales Profit by Fiscal 2030
data.description: According to Jin10, Toyota Motor aims to raise operating profit from businesses outside new car sales by about 40% to 3 trillion yen, or about $19.2 billion, by fiscal 2030, according to Nikkei. The Japanese automaker wants to profit from its existing global fleet of 150 million Toyota vehicles and move away from a business model closely tied to new car sales.

data.title: NVIDIA's Jensen Huang Says OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Marks AGI Arrival
data.description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra has brought artificial general intelligence, or AGI, and said the model was trained on about 100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems. He also said 400,000 GPUs are coming online next, according to BeInCrypto, after first posting a higher figure of 300,000 and then deleting it. OpenAI has not said AGI has arrived, and its president Greg Brockman stopped short of that claim.

data.title: Amazon Cargo Jet Overruns Runway, Shuts Miami Airport
data.description:

data.title: Peter Schiff Rejects Bitcoin Backing Argument As BTC Trades Near $79,600
data.description:
Peter Schiff reopened the Bitcoin-backing debate, arguing that miners’ energy use leaves nothing behind to support Bitcoin, while Bitcoin maximalist Jeff Swanson had called the asset the future of money. According to BeInCrypto, Schiff said energy is gone once spent, so it cannot back Bitcoin, and he contrasted that with gold, which remains after mining.

Swanson also cited $39 trillion in U.S. debt, but Treasury data put total public debt above $40 trillion on Aug. 18 and at $40.10 trillion on Sept. 3. Bitcoin (BTC) traded near $79,600 on Sunday, down about 1.5% over 24 hours.

data.title: Iran to Raise Gasoline Prices for High-Usage Consumers
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani said on Sunday that Iran will raise gasoline prices for users who consume more than 110 liters per month starting Tuesday. She said the first and second quota tiers, including 110 liters, will remain unchanged, while the third-tier quota price will rise to 100,000 Iranian rials per liter, or about 4 cents at the free-market exchange rate. Mohajerani said the increase will affect only consumers who need more than 110 liters of gasoline per month, and that the adjustment is due to the current situation. She added that other drivers can still buy up to 60 liters at 15,000 rials per liter and another 50 liters at 30,000 rials per liter.
